in_sanskrit.name: Sahajamal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born with blessings
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sahajamal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sahajamal is a name derived from Sanskrit and Hindi origin. It is a compound name, composed of two words: Sahaja (born with) and Mala (garland of blessings). This name signifies that the child was born with blessings from the gods and the universe.
